reviewHighlights: One-way trust is outgoing on the trusting resource domain and incoming on the trusted identity domain; user access travels opposite the trust arrow.
AD Connector has no directory replica; a self-managed DC replica on EC2 has a separate operational responsibility.
Configured Identity Center access-control mapping overrides the matching SAML attribute value.
Direct SAML API example: requested 2h, role max4h and SessionNotOnOrAfter+1h yields +1h expiry; requesting above role max fails.
Applied checkpoint distinguishes absent account assignment from expected denial of an unapproved write action.
